trickyParts: The 18 entrypoint's refusal needs three conditions together: PGDATA at the image default, a fresh data directory, and /var/lib/postgresql/data being a mount point. The negative-control Job therefore starts on a fresh volume; a restart of an initialised container never reaches it.

Because the db container never exits, no Job reports Complete. The driver polls the client container's terminated exit code instead, and for the negative control the db container's, then reads both logs and deletes the Job.
The four Go skip messages carry no --mount and need none: the image's only declared VOLUME is /var/lib/postgresql, so a mountless run meets no refusal.
The tmpfs comments at stage2-tmux-supervision.sh:406-407 and README.md:245-246 stay true at the new path, since the 18 image's one anonymous volume is /var/lib/postgresql.
